title: Strict source-paint core recovery: independent graphics and machine regression proof
scope: Input preparation only; no change to stitch generation. Strict opaque constant-colour cores, not tolerant JPEG clustering, semantic segmentation, image reconstruction or sewout validation.

methodology.preparation: Exact baseline git archive and final copied Python source snapshot; one isolated subprocess per case. Inputs identical by SHA-256. Proof runs capture stages, independent masks and SVG bytes; their timings are excluded from performance comparisons.
methodology.oracle: Known categorical SVG masks rendered independently with crispEdges. Actual interpreted bitmap labels projected to reference pixel centres, palettes matched to declared paints at Lab deltaE <=14. Area, IoU and spill measure graphics fidelity, not physical thread coverage. 29 known-truth controls, including 19 true accents and 10 false-accent negatives.
methodology.machine: Decode PES and DST with pyembroidery; compare source input with independently saved interpreted SVG to isolate input interpretation. Seven reference cases compare exact commands, thread list, decisions, statistics excluding time, file bytes, preview and rendered topology.
methodology.performance: Nine cases, one unrecorded warm-up then seven measured preparations in each isolated case process, stage hooks without oracle snapshots. p50 and linearly interpolated p95. Dev machine was not reserved; other agents' tests/builds may run concurrently. These data expose costs, not a controlled speedup claim.
methodology.rss: macOS resource.ru_maxrss in bytes, maximum over whole subprocess including imports/native allocations. Separate stress subprocesses, single observation per snapshot; not a per-stage Python allocation peak.
methodology.stress: 16 MP synthetic checkerboard and seeded opaque random RGB through sample_bitmap only. The latter represents colour complexity, not a semantic photograph. Maximum working side 960 px. Checkerboard has no significant source components, so topology_preserved=false is intentionally reported despite zero scoped issues.

limits.remaining_negative_artifact: JPEG35 red/blue diagonal has two existing unmatched paints with interpreted area 0.013660 mm2; unchanged. No new unmatched negative paints introduced.
limits.machine_scope: Decode, finite coordinates, command/file equality and omission checks do not prove textile sewout quality or manufacturer acceptance. Union Jack retains its pre-existing 58 omitted tiny regions; this input-preparation lot does not fix the downstream detail limit.
limits.cost: Source core recovery and actual quantizer audits add work. Union Jack median preparation increases about 0.64 to 1.68 s with identical output; small flat controls about 14-16 ms to 89-119 ms. Performance work remains separate from this bounded fidelity fix.
limits.jpeg: No tolerant colour core discovery was integrated. H JPEG35/75 happens to contain usable constant decoded cores; this does not establish general JPEG detail recovery.

reproduction.script_status: All proof scripts, source snapshots, truth masks and source fixtures are ignored local artifacts, not repository product code. Compact report can be committed. Real logos originate from local user inputs; full replay requires those identical hashed fixtures.
